notes.title: Striden | Hotfix Update & Upcoming Content News
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hello Rebels![/b][/h3][p]We’re finally ready to roll out our delayed hotfix patch! Just to be clear: we’ve been working on two updates at the same time. The hotfix goes live today, and at the end of September we’ll be releasing our very first [b]content update patch[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s start by talking about that upcoming content update. Over the past two weeks, we’ve begun development on a brand-new game mode with the working title [b]Kontroll[/b]. It’s heavily inspired by Domination/Conquest, but with a unique Striden twist.[/p][p][/p][p]Our goal with Kontroll is to create a mode that’s easy to jump into for new players: pick a soldier class, choose your weapon loadout, and get straight into the action. Expect fast-paced matches with quick respawns, set in a section of our brand-new map [b]Nuke 08[/b], which takes place in Stockholm, Sweden. Nuke 08 is being built specifically with Kontroll in mind, based on community feedback. Matches will be [b]5v5 (10 players total)[/b], and just like in Transmit, you’ll still progress through ranks and unlock weapons. We’ll share more details in future updates![/p][p]On top of that, we’re also adding a brand-new [b]Transmit map[/b] called [b]Souppat[/b]—a reimagining of our co-op map [i]Berget[/i], redesigned to fit perfectly into Transmit.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]This hotfix patch we release today will include:[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Easy Anti-Cheat[/b] fully integrated into the game[/p][/*][*][p][b]New backend monitoring system[/b] – lets us see what’s happening on the servers without logging into the game, making it easier to act against disruptive users and gather data for balancing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mute function[/b] in the scoreboard for VOIP/Proximity chat + soldier voice lines[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fixes[/b] for explosive weapons dealing damage through walls[/p][/*][*][p][b]Toggle sprint function[/b] added[/p][/*][*][p][b]Toggle crouch function[/b] added[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rank corrections[/b] – We are working on an overhaul of the progression system to fix lost ranks. We can now restore lost or bugged ranks retroactively. If you have lost your rank, send us a DM in our Discord. [/p][/*][*][p][b]DLSS bug.[/b] Fixed excessive Log Spamming caused by DLSS incorrectly trying to enable itself[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Next up, we’re gearing up for the Steam event at the end of September! That’s when we’ll restart our marketing push, pack the servers, and bring Striden roaring back to life![/p][p][/p][h2][i][b]Don´t miss out our [u]Let´s play Striden[/u] event every Saturday 7:00PM CET[/b][/i][/h2][p][/p][h3]Don’t forget to join our  [url="https://discord.com/invite/Wyjcw5Qu6B" style="button"] Discord[/url]  for behind-the-scenes content, direct chats with the devs, a place to share your feedback, and to team up with fellow Rebels to play Striden![/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.3.5 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Rebels! [/h2][p][/p][p]It's almost been a week since the launch of Early Access — and it’s been a week to remember. 
[/p][p]Before we dive into the upcoming update, we want to once again thank you for all the feedback and constructive criticism, helping to push STRIDEN forward. Feel free to join our Discord to get in direct contact with us more easily.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Wyjcw5Qu6B" style="button"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Update 0.3.5 Patch Notes[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This Friday, we’ll be rolling out an update. The servers will be temporarily down during the update process.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Rank Progression[/b][/p][p]Fixed an issue causing players to jump from Rank 16 to 25 unexpectedly.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Moose Tank: Now limited to[b] [/b]10 shots[/p][/*][*][p]Radioactive Bear: Can no longer destroy destructible objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Construction Kill Removed[/p][/*][*][p]Airdrops: Increased to 16 total airdrops across all maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Soldier Voices: Reduced frequency and spam to minimize audio clutter.[/p][/*][*][p]Easy Anti-Cheat: Initial implementation for increased security. [/p][/*][*][p]Added Toggle Sprint [/p][/*][*][p]Added Toggle Crouch[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]Grinder Bug: Fixed a Bug that allowed players to start breach and walk away while holding down breach button to complete a breach.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapon Balancing[/b][/p][p][/p][p]All shotguns: Reduced Spare Ammo from 40 to 20.[/p][p][/p][p]Remington[/p][list][*][p]Pellets per shot reduced to 6[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced damage range[/p][/*][*][p]Now require a Rare (blue) weapon part[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]SVT-40[/p][list][*][p]Max spare ammo set to 60 rounds[/p][/*][*][p]Slower fire rate[/p][/*][*][p]Increased bullet spread when hipfire[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]M69[/p][p]• Recoil pattern made slightly more aggressive for added challenge[/p]

notes.title: Open Beta around the corner & Development update
notes.notes: [h2]Hello Rebels! [/h2][p][/p][p][b]Time for our grand finale playtest session of STRIDEN before the Early Access launch! On June 27th, we’re opening up our playtest app to the public for one final free playtest weekend. To join, make sure to sign up for the playtest on our Steam page.[/b][/p][p][b]If you’ve played before, just sit back and relax, you’ll automatically get access when the beta starts.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]So, what have we been up to this past week?[/b][/p][p]We’ve been fully focused on tracking down bugs, fixing performance issues, and preparing our back-end systems.[/p][p]Every week, we run at least one internal test, and we’ve also held two stress test sessions with full servers playing STRIDEN for about three hours each to make sure everything works as it should.[/p][p]Our talented, tight-knit team has been hard at work developing fresh new content and replacing placeholder assets.[/p][p][/p][p]Our team of interns has made fantastic progress on our new urban map, [b]Nuke 08[/b].[/p][p][b]Nuke 08[/b] is set in Sweden’s capital, Stockholm, where a tactical nuke has destroyed large parts of the city. This setting brings a fresh twist to the game and stands out from our other maps — with a mix of tight close-quarters combat areas and wide open streets with varied elevation.[/p][p]This new map won’t be included in the Open Beta, but we’re aiming to have a playable version ready by late summer 2025.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549018/63b99d3c5f8fa55eef7cb9ad4db1b41dca61486a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549018/720b31b6477c704578971f28f3e872efdf824c47.png"][/img][/p][h2]Progress with our Powerspikes[/h2][p]The biggest update is that we’ve added a new system to how Powerspikes work. Now, you have to choose which Powerspike (animal) you want to play [b]before[/b] each match — and you’ll be locked to that animal for the entire match. You make your choice in the match lobby before deploying onto the battlefield.[/p][p]This means your team will need to think more strategically about which Powerspikes fit the map and your overall tactics. Powerspikes still charge up based on your individual player score, and when you activate them, you must place them carefully on the map [b]no more Moose Tanks spawning inside Strongholds![/b] It also now takes time to channel into your chosen animal, so you can’t instantly spawn a Powerspike anymore. Enemies can attack you while you’re channeling, so pick your moment and location wisely.[/p][p]We’ve also removed the timer for how long you can stay in your Powerspike. Now, you can cancel it at any time. Plus, you can now spot enemy Powerspikes to alert your teammates.[/p][p]With these changes, Powerspike balance has improved significantly not every player can just summon a bear or a Moose Tank anymore.[/p][p][/p][p]Our beloved [b]Moose Tank[/b] has received a lot of love too. We’ve reworked its driving and movement to make it feel less clunky. Enemies can now destroy the Moose itself, which disables the cannon turret — so if you’re facing one, aim for the Moose! Think of it like tracking a tank in other games.[/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Radioactive Bear[/b] has also been polished for smoother movement. The biggest new feature is that teammates can now [b]ride[/b] a friendly bear! Just approach it, hold the interact button, and voilà, you’re basically Rambo on a Scandinavian bear.[/p][p][/p][p]For the [b]Eagle Hook[/b], we’ve continued improving the flight controls. This Powerspike is quickly becoming a STRIDEN favorite, it opens up a whole new dimension for transporting teammates or trolling enemies by grabbing them and dropping them from the sky.[/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Bomber Eagle[/b] is both amazing and terrifying, depending on which side you’re on. Having a flying bomb plane in STRIDEN is perfect for clearing out an Air Supply zone or blasting a pesky sniper hiding on a hill.[/p][p]But once we added birds to the game, we realized something was missing. A counter to hunt them down. So, naturally, we made a fighter jet… well, a [b]Fighter Eagle[/b]! This bad boy comes equipped with a light machine gun (MG-42) and two air-to-ground missiles. So keep an eye on the skies during the next playtest![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ebcui1l8zMk;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Personality for the Class Soldiers[/h2][p]All of our soldier voices have now been replaced with real voice actors — a huge milestone for us, finally replacing all the placeholder lines in the game. Some lines have already become iconic, so we made sure to keep a few classics while adding plenty of new ones. With real voice talent, we were able to get much more creative and bring our soldiers to life.[/p][p]We’ve also programmed soldiers to react more naturally to what’s happening around them. For example, they now shout warnings about incoming grenades, scream or curse when suppressed, and react vocally when they take damage. These changes have made a big difference to the game’s immersion — now it really feels like you’re in the middle of a chaotic, intense battle.[/p][p]More shouts, more personality, and even more epic moments for everyone![/p][previewyoutube="_ejnnonvHb4;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Suppression & New Death Camera[/h2][p]As I mentioned when talking about the new soldier voices, we’ve now added a [b]suppression system[/b] to the game. Before you tear your hair out, don’t worry! It’s very subtle, but it makes the combat feel more intense and realistic, adding to the immersion when bullets whip past your head.[/p][p]We’re also planning to fine-tune it so that different weapons cause different levels of suppression. For example, light machine guns will create more suppression than a submachine gun.[/p][previewyoutube="dABaJyXxzpQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]So, if you get suppressed, take a few bullets, and get killed you’ll now see it all through our improved death camera. Previously, we had a first-person death sequence, but in about 80% of cases, you’d just see your body flying away like a happy dolphin in the ocean. It looked odd, and we also got feedback that the kill cam lingered too long on the enemy who killed you.[/p][p]Now, your view follows the head of your soldier as they fall, making the sequence feel much more grounded and realistic. We’ve also added new camera effects to enhance the impact. Plus, the time spent showing the enemy who killed you has been shortened for a smoother experience.[/p][p][/p][h2]Construction System — Almost Finished[/h2][p]A big part of the game is our [b]construction system[/b], which isn’t just for base defense and team resources it also plays a key strategic role out on the battlefield. We’ve now polished the repair system, including how the [b]Sentry Gun[/b] works. Enemies can destroy a Sentry Gun, but not completely the owning team can repair it and bring it back into action.[/p][p]We’ve also renamed our [b]Vending Machine[/b] to [b]Loot Storage[/b] to make its purpose clearer: it’s for storing loot. A new feature is that Loot Storage now generates new consumables over time. So, when you respawn at your base ([b]Stronghold[/b]), you can grab a can of beans or other supplies before heading back into the fight.[/p][p]If you raid an enemy Stronghold and destroy their construction items, you’ll be rewarded with blueprints. And if you destroy an item that stores loot like a weapon station all the stored items will be dropped on the ground.[/p][p]So make sure your base defenses are solid![/p][p][/p][h2]Respawn System[/h2][p]We’re currently working on a [b]spawn protection system[/b] to reduce spawn killing, with a main focus on protecting Strongholds (bases). This has been a common piece of feedback for a long time players getting killed by base campers and we hope this update will help solve that issue.[/p][p]We’ve also added a change so that you always respawn with a full clip/magazine after being killed. Additionally, we’re working on a system where, if you join a match already in progress, you’ll spawn with a basic submachine gun to get you into the action right away.[/p][p][/p][h2]Radioactivity — Less Deadly[/h2][p]After replacing our placeholder radioactive fog with our epic dynamic weather system, we realized we wanted players to engage in more battles during radioactive storms. So, we’ve tweaked how much radiation drains your gas mask filter and how much damage it deals. Now, your filter lasts longer, giving you more time to fight in radioactive zones.[/p][p][/p][h2]Audio[/h2][p]We’re still working on sound mixing to make sure we don’t blow out your eardrums during intense firefights. With so many sounds playing at once and a lot happening on-screen, getting the balance right is a big challenge, especially since we don’t have a dedicated audio engineer in the studio. But we’re doing our best to deliver a great audio experience for Early Access, with proper reverb zones and realistic sound behavior at different distances.[/p][p][/p][h2]UI/UX[/h2][p]We’ve started production on new menus to make navigating the settings and other screens much easier. Up until now, we’ve been using very basic placeholders, but what the team is working on now looks really promising.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bugs and Performance[/h2][p]Of course, we’ve also been busy fixing bugs and improving performance over the past week. We spend a lot of time on this to ensure a smoother experience for everyone. One of the biggest fixes was resolving screen tearing and flickering, this was a nightmare to track down, but switching to a different anti-aliasing method finally solved it.[/p][p]We’ve also made server performance more stable, especially on our 60 Hz servers.[/p][p][/p][h2]Less Than a Month to Early Access Launch![/h2][p]We’re working around the clock to deliver an amazing first version of STRIDEN, and we couldn’t be more excited to share it with players around the world. As mentioned in earlier blog posts, this is just the beginning of our journey. Together with you, our community, we’ll shape a fast-paced, fun, and action-packed looter shooter.[/p][p]We’re committed to listening to your feedback not only for fine-tuning gameplay but also for shaping future content. Your voice will truly have an impact on the development of STRIDEN.[/p][p][b]Early Access will be priced at $24.99[/b], with a special 20% launch-week discount to thank our early supporters. This pricing ensures we can maintain servers and continue developing the game without relying on crowdfunding. When you buy STRIDEN, you’re directly supporting our team and the game’s future.[/p][p]We’re also planning cosmetic DLC soldier skins, weapon skins, and more that will be purely optional and won’t affect gameplay. No pay-to-win mechanics or map-based DLCs that split the player base.[/p][p][/p][p]Starting now, we’ll post weekly updates here on Steam leading up to launch, plus exclusive behind-the-scenes footage from our studio where 80% of the team is hard at work bringing STRIDEN to life.[/p][p]Get ready STRIDEN’s Early Access is just around the corner![/p][previewyoutube="dNG0FZAGq3c;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/Wyjcw5Qu6B"]Discord[/url] to join our community and say hey to the devs![/p][p][b]Take care and see you at the Open Beta June 27th.[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Release Date and Dev Updates
notes.notes:
[b][u]Hello Rebels![/u][/b]

Time for a fresh update on what's happening with [b]STRIDEN[/b] and the progress we’ve made!

With the Open Beta still fresh in our minds, we've learned a lot. First off, implementing a new network code can introduce new challenges but ultimately, it boosts performance. So, what caused our network issues?

We’ve made several updates to hit registration to create a more consistent and satisfying gunplay experience. We’ve also reworked the progression system and increased server tickrates. While these changes were necessary, they did affect server reliability and had a negative impact on proximity chat and servers. But after a lot of hard work, we’re now in a [u]much better[/u] place with nearly everything back on track.

To ensure stability, we’ve partnered with Nortify, a QA company that’s stress-testing our game with long sessions and full servers. We’re determined to make the next playtest a rock-solid experience for all of you.

We also fixed one of our most frustrating bugs "The Terminator Bug" which caused some players to become immortal. A nasty glitch that made it look like people were cheating. [u]Not anymore[/u].

While analyzing kill and death events, we also squashed the annoying kill trade bug. No more mysterious simultaneous kills during hectic firefights!

Gunplay now feels tighter and more responsive. We’ve added first-person tracers to better visualize spread and bloom, and improved third-person tracers so you can clearly see where enemies are firing from.

[h2]Now, for the big news:[/h2]

[b]STRIDEN is launching into Early Access on July 11![/b]
This is a huge milestone for us. After more than three years of development (and over 600 hours of internal playtesting on my part alone), we’re finally ready to open the gates.

[h2]So what does Early Access mean for STRIDEN?[/h2]

It’s the beginning of our journey with you—the community. We’re releasing a solid first version of the game, and we’ll keep building from here, actively listening to your feedback. A roadmap is on the way, outlining our plans through to full release about a year from now.

Your voice will help shape the game. You’ll be able to vote on things like the next map or weapon, beyond what’s already planned. We want to develop STRIDEN with the community—not just for it.

[h2]About us:[/h2]
5-Fortress is a small indie studio based in northern Sweden. At our largest, we’ve been 8 developers; for the past 8 months, it’s been just 3 of us, supported by talented interns from local game development programs. Recently, we’ve partnered with Yahaha Games, which is allowing us to scale up again. They’re also helping us with backend infrastructure for launch—ensuring we deliver on our promises.

Our goal: a high-quality indie FPS looter-shooter that stands out from the AAA crowd. No pay-to-win. No paid battle passes. A fresh take on familiar mechanics with a tight, fun gameloop—and always developed in conversation with you, the community.

[h2]Here’s a sneak peek of what we’ve been working on lately:[/h2]

☢️ [b]New Radioactive Fog/Storm[/b]
The old green fog was… fine. But now, the radioactive storm brings dynamic weather that affects visibility, atmosphere, and the soundscape of the entire map. Way more immersive—and way more intense.

[previewyoutube=fTuJRdPIOgg;full][/previewyoutube]


🧰 [b]New Lobby System – Customize Your Class[/b]
You’ll now be able to tailor your class to your playstyle—pick your construction items, outfits (coming soon!), and most importantly, your Powerspike. Only one Powerspike per match, making for deeper team strategy. Plus, this system sets the stage for adding more content in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549018/db23891e28f02a3d67fe16b8b45d2a5572bf8650.png[/img]

🗺️ [b]New Tactical Map – Plan to Win[/b]
A redesigned map interface makes it easier to navigate, issue commands, and coordinate with your team. Zoom in and out, mark objectives, and take control of the match flow like never before.


🦅 [b]Polished Powerspikes[/b]
We’ll have 5 Powerspikes available in Early Access. The newest? Birds. Yes, really.
“Eagle Hook” can fly teammates across the map—or drop enemies from altitude.
“Bomb Eagle”? Just what it sounds like.
We're also revisiting old favorites like the Bear and Moose, improving movement and fixing spawn logic (no more Moose Tanks inside Strongholds).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549018/03e1c316337d7a294d196a2b887e47bc3b78f778.png[/img]


🌆 [b]New Map – Urban Combat[/b]
Our amazing interns are working on something epic: a nuked town full of massive ruined buildings and hidden military bunkers. Think brutal, intense, and full of tactical opportunities.

🎶 [b]Our own soundtrack[/b]
We are removing all placeholder music and going full scale on a own STRIDEN soundtrack.

There’s even [b]more[/b] exciting content coming soon. We’re going all in on this and hope you’ll enjoy everything we’re building.

[b]We’re planning one last Open Playtest before the Early Access launch on July 11—stay tuned![/b]

Please help us spread the word—tell your friends, tell your rivals—and make sure to Wishlist STRIDEN and follow us on Steam. Don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Wyjcw5Qu6B]Discord[/url] for weekly updates and to share your feedback directly.

Take care,
/Johan

notes.title: PLAYTEST WEEKEND: NUCLEAR WINTER PATCH
notes.notes:
[h3]The Winter Nuclear war is here! Nausta has been drained in a snowstorm and Vargen is now experiencing a brutal thunderstorm that will make enemy camouflage even more effective. 

All of us in the studio are so grateful for the warm, transparent, honest, and mature feedback you provided throughout the week. To show our appreciation, we're excited to announce a new update for this weekend.

We will close the open playtest at Monday June 17th at 00.00 CEST. [/h3]
